name: Niko P.
headline:
CDTM | HCI | Mover of Tomorrow 2024 | Young Explorers 

Biodiversity enthusiast 🦉 | HCI @ LMU 🎓 | Mediaengineer by training 👾
summary:
On a journey combining my passions for wild nature, creative innovation, and technology for a positive impact. 🌱 

Over the last ten years, I empowered young adults to become changemakers in the context of the climate crisis and the loss of biodiversity. For the last four years we facilitated an exchange format bridging the gap between German corporate leaders and young environmental activists. 🌲 

These experiences led to my current focus: integrating biodiversity and nature into core business solutions, driving sustainable innovation from within the economy sphere. 🦉
